entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with C.G. Case No. 11 of 2014 pending in the Court of Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate, Latehar allegedly for the offence registered under Sections 3(1)(zz)(iii)&(viii), 59(iii) read with Sections 26,27,48 of the Food Safety & Standard Act, 2006.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that upon forensic examination by the State Food & Drug Laboratory, Ranchi on a sample of Laddu seized from the petitioner's shop, metanil yellow synthetic colour, which is not permissible synthetic colour, was detected for which he has been prosecuted.
However, penal provision of Section 59(iii), does not apply in the instant case as no one has come forward to allege about any injury or grievous injury as a result of such consumption.

Otherwise, even if the allegation is accepted, provision of Section 59(i) is applicable,
which is bailable in nature as no injury is said to be caused to any person.
Therefore, he may be enlarged on anticipatory bail as the alleged offence is not of such serious nature.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.

Having regard to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, it appears that on examination some impermissible chemical has been found in the sample obtained from the petitioner's shop, but no one has come forward to allege that any injury or grievous injury has resulted because of such consumption.
Therefore, in my view, the petitioner is entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.

Therefore, in the event of arrest/surrender, the petitioner, above named, is directed to be released Nirmal Kumar Sharma vs The State Of Jharkhand on 21 May, 2014 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148036668/
1 on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rs Ten Thousand Only) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Arresting Authority and/or learned Addl.
